about__description: ● Possess solid professional skills, have a systematic and in-depth understanding of the entire art process in game development, and be proficient in all aspects of game art, from early design to final implementation, production specifications, and development cycles.</br>

● Dedicated to game art creation and visual realization, with a deep understanding of the entire art implementation process. Successively served as a scene modeler, level artist, technical artist, and other positions, possessing multi-role experience, mainly skilled in scene direction and project management.</br>

● Possess certain team and project management skills and project risk awareness, and be able to effectively communicate and coordinate teamwork. Have a strong sense of responsibility, excellent time management skills, and strong execution ability, capable of efficiently advancing individual and team tasks.</br>
● Possess strong self-planning ability and proactive learning awareness.
